name: pillar-brief-guard
description: Enforces the pillar-brief rules in any session: no article idea without a parent article, no product selection or article writing without an approved (<= 365 days) pillar brief, no brief approval without a named approver.

supabaseServer.title: Supabase MCP server name
supabaseServer.description: Server name as /mcp lists it, used for read-only execute_sql on pillar_briefs and refresh_runs.

approvers.title: Approved human approvers
approvers.description: Comma-separated names allowed to approve a pillar brief (pillar_brief.py approve --by, run-pillar-brief.yml approved_by). Case-insensitive.
